title: Chicago 2027: *last call* to apply
hook: Applications for the 2027 Chicago Marathon close tomorrow, 29 Oct.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: Applications for the 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon opened 8 Oct. They close 29 Oct at 2 p.m. Central Time.

slides.label: Key dates
slides.c: Drawing results arrive on 8 Dec. The entry fee is $250 for U.S. and $260 for international applicants.

slides.label: How to enter
slides.c: Apply only through the official Chicago Marathon website. Applying is not a guaranteed spot: it is a drawing.

facts.claim: Applications opened 8 Oct 2026 8am CT, close 29 Oct 2026 2pm CT
Fee $250 US / $260 international; drawing results 8 Dec

caption:
NEWS: Chicago Marathon 2027 applications close tomorrow

The general application window for the 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon closes Thursday 29 Oct at 2 p.m. Central Time (as of 28 Oct). Drawing results follow on 8 Dec.

Source: Bank of America Newsroom, Marathon Handbook
